Question: Who should (prefer to) cook after marriage if both are working, men or women? Why?
Answer: In my marriage, I do. Not because I am a woman, because I love cooking and cleaning. It is a kind of stress buster for me. I do not have any domestic help in my house. I prefer doing things my way. The home after you are done dusting feels amazing. The cutlery after you have washed them and arranged in the shelf feels divine to me. The aroma of food being prepared is out of this world. The plate full of finely chopped vegetables is beauty. After a long day at work, I actually want to cook for us. Generally over the weekends, I will try a new recipe. I love cakes, so I have baked many of them. I agree, there are some days when I am not well or simply dont feel like cooking then he takes the charge. Maximum he can do is oats, khichdi and Maggie. :)
